data.text:
Wpms/1484/2017 on 13 June, 2024 
Author: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
 proceedings or
No Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  WPMS No.1484 of 2017  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Gopal K. Verma, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
2. Petitioner is a Meat Seller. The Chief Veterinary Officer, Nagar Nigam, Dehradun cancelled the 'No Objection Certificate' earlier issued in favour of petitioner vide order dated 13.06.2017. In this writ petition, petitioner has challenged the said order and the consequential order dated 16.06.2017 passed by Food Safety Officer, Nagar Nigam, Dehradun. 
3. In paragraph nos.16 & 17 of the writ petition, it is mentioned that principles of natural justice was not followed before cancelling 'No Objection Certificate' and suspending the license. No counter affidavit has been filed to the writ petition so far; although, time was given for said purpose, on 29.06.2017. 
4. In view of unrebutted averments made in paragraph nos.16 & 17 of the writ petition, the writ petition deserves to be allowed, as order, which entails civil consequences to a person, cannot be passed without affording reasonable opportunity of hearing. 
5. On this short point alone, the impugned orders dated 13.06.2017 and 16.06.2017 are liable to be set aside and are hereby set aside. The writ petition is allowed. However, the respondents shall be at liberty to pass fresh order in respect of petitioner, as per law. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 13.06.2024 Arpan WPMS/1484/2017 on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12334599/
